newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan CPC awards Nov and Dec fuel oil cargoes.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan CPC awards Nov and Dec fuel oil cargoes.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) said on Wednesday it has awarded one 38,000-tonne cargo each of 0.5 percent sulphur and 1.0 percent sulphur fuel oil in its tender which closed on Tuesday.
CPC purchased the 0.5 percent sulphur fuel oil for delivery between November 21 and December 20 at "low $140s", a company official told Reuters.
The 1.0 percent sulphur fuel oil for delivery between December 6-12 was purchased at $130-$135 per tonne, the source said.
Both cargoes would be delivered to Keelung, Shenao or Taichung and were awarded on a cost-and freight (c-and-f) basis.
In its last tender for delivery between November 16-December 10, CPC purchased one 0.5 percent sulphur grade fuel oil cargo at $141 per tonne c-and-f.
